claims: NASA currently targets early 2028 for the launch of Artemis IV.
Artemis IV will be the first crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17, according to NASA's official mission overview.
Artemis IV will use the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket to send astronauts to the lunar south pole.
Artemis IV will contribute to building the Gateway station.
Artemis IV's mission goal is the second human lunar landing of the Artemis program, following Artemis III.
Artemis IV's launch site is Kennedy Space Center, Launch Complex 39B.
Astronauts on Artemis IV will dock with the Lunar Gateway in orbit.
Astronauts on Artemis IV will descend to the lunar surface for about a week of research.
Artemis IV follows the crewed lunar landing scheduled for 2027 (Artemis III).
